## One-minute summary

Project: MAX Grounding

Purpose: Provide a self-hostable evidence-first grounding engine that retrieves, validates, compresses, and cites external evidence for LLMs and agents without giving the model authority to invent facts.

Primary users: application developers, agent developers, operators of self-hosted AI systems

Expected outcomes:
- grounded responses backed by explicit evidence and citations
- bounded and observable retrieval behavior
- cross-platform core runtime with containerized service integrations

## Main user workflows

### FLOW-PHASE-DELIVERY — Governed phase delivery

Move each implementation phase from isolated branch to accepted main without bypassing executable evidence.

Authority: GitHub Actions required checks

- BRANCH_ACTIVE -> CANDIDATE : complete minimum scoped implementation and tests
- CANDIDATE -> ACTIONS_PASS : all required GitHub Actions checks pass
- ACTIONS_PASS -> MERGED_MAIN : merge pull request
- MERGED_MAIN -> MAIN_REVALIDATED : GitHub Actions revalidate merged main
